Schema
CREATE TABLE laps(lap_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, driver_number INTEGER, driver_name TEXT, track TEXT, elapsed_ms INTEGER)
Question
Find the 3 fastest different drivers, one entry per driver number, using each driver’s fastest recorded lap. Show only the driver name and track of that lap.

message.content: {"targets":[{"rule":"entity","scope":"all_rows","table":"laps","display":["driver_name","track"],"key":["driver_number"],"order":"elapsed_ms","direction":"ASC","n":3,"grain_evidence":"3 fastest different drivers, one entry per driver number, using each driver’s fastest recorded lap","projection_evidence":"Show only the driver name and track of that lap.","ties":[]}]}

output.sql: WITH candidates AS (SELECT DISTINCT "driver_name", "track", "driver_number", "elapsed_ms" FROM "laps" WHERE "elapsed_ms" IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT "driver_name", "track", "driver_number", "elapsed_ms", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "driver_number" ORDER BY "elapsed_ms" ASC) AS "__top_n_position" FROM candidates) SELECT "driver_name", "track" FROM ranked WHERE "__top_n_position"=1 ORDER BY "elapsed_ms" ASC LIMIT 3
